after_entry.name: HOPS
after_entry.role: Ancient-pathogen candidate assessment from metagenomic alignment evidence
after_entry.coverage_note: P002 reports HOPS assessment of MALT output and candidate profiles; low-read candidates can remain unassessable. The declared tested version/profiles implement those output-producing operations. Author version/settings are unreported and are not inferred. The 2017 database and custom MALT0.5.2 screening remain distinct requirements.
after_entry.implementation_scope: Owned unchanged HOPS_Main me_po from the declared GPL HOPS0.35 distribution, original MaltExtract1.7 under pinned Java8 and original AMPS under public R4.0.5. Complete classified RMA6/resource capture, literal target lookup, original extraction/summary/damage tables, candidate PDFs, heatmap/TSV/RData and native complete-field checks. Explicit source-def-anc retains original sampling/destacking/deduplication; complete-def-anc deliberately disables them and changes the method. Manual authentication, upstream MALT index/alignment, author settings and historical database reconstruction remain separate. Read HOPS_INTEGRATION.md.
after_entry.validation_note: Three complete original productions; independent stock/complete launcher comparisons match173 scientific files and280 RData fields per profile, with two/four expected PDFs and51 differing scientific files between methods. All41 focused/adjacent tests pass on Windows JDK21 and25. Complete public replay restores5665 logical files, freshly decodes all three workspaces and rejects10 specifically rehashed contradictions. Four dependency/capacity/prefix controls launch no upstream analysis. Original driver exit0 with plotting-child exit1 is retained and unadmitted. Linux JDK21 execution includes the JDK25-built application; Linux JDK25 execution is untested. Saved consistency checks do not authenticate a producer or establish biological truth.
